## Cross-cutting refactor matrix

| Pattern | Files | Safe reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Duplicate VR overlay UI builders | `BackendConnectionManager`, `MidiStatusWidgetController` | Extract static `VrWorldCanvasBuilder` (keep sizes/colors identical) |
| `FindObjectOfType` polling | MIDI stack, `ProgressDisplay`, `PianoGameManager` | Cache on scene load; keep fallback |
| Manual JSON | `AuthService.SerializePracticeSessionRequest` | Only replace if byte-identical output verified |
| Verbose MIDI diagnostics | `DirectMidiReceiver` | Gate existing logs behind `verboseMidiLogging` |
| Dead code | `UDPReceiver`, `UDPBeacon`, `SessionItem.SeleccionarSesion`, `PianoPauseMenu.CloseMenuAndResumeIfNeeded`, `Initializer.url`, `ShowRepertorio.UpdateSongItemButton` | Remove after scene/prefab confirmation |
| Scene string sprawl | 8 files | Centralize `SceneNames` static class (**values must match table above exactly**) |

## Mode summary

| Layer | Shared | Piano-specific | Canto-specific | Mode-aware |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core/Auth/DTO/History | UserSession, NetworkConfig, AlertManager, AuthService, BackendConnectionManager, EnvLoader, DTOs, HistoryManager, Login, Register, Menu*, SelectedSongManager, SongItem, ShowRepertorio, EvolutionGraphs, ConfigSceneUI, DetallesSesionUI | MIDI stack, MidiAudioManager, ResultsPanel, ProgressDisplay, PianoPauseMenu, PianoCalibrator, RecenterPlayer (spawn) | — (canto uses separate `SingNetwork/*`, `SUDPReceiver`) | SongItem, DetallesSesionUI, EvolutionGraphsController |
| VR | SmoothFollowCanvas, ReticleToLineEnd, QuestXRInteractionController (mostly) | PianoCalibrator, RecenterPlayer, QuestXR piano overrides | — | QuestXR hand-tracking off in PianoGame |
| Likely dead | UDPReceiver, UDPBeacon, Initializer (minimal), SceneLoader, CambiadorEscenas | — | — | — |

**Note:** `Register.cs` defines class **`Registrar`**, not `Register` — prefab/Inspector references use the script file name.
